usedFor: JustCall runs the phone calls and texts, and Dropbox stores files through “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Ended” in JustCall, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A finished call can save a file from a public link into a chosen Dropbox folder.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” lets you choose add, replace or update for existing files, so set that deliberately.
